body:
What is Quamtrax?

Quamtrax is a brand in vitamins and supplements, weight-loss products, protein bars and snacks and amino acids. The THH Europe catalogue currently lists 60 products from Quamtrax, including Quamtrax ALA – 60 caps, Quamtrax Diuretix – 90 caps and Quamtrax Oatmeal. Together they come in 132 flavours and variants.

Buy Quamtrax wholesale

Want to stock Quamtrax for resale? THH Europe is your wholesale partner in the Benelux. You order from our own stock and pay wholesale prices from just 1 unit.

  • wholesale prices from 1 unit

  • shipped from our own stock
  • a dedicated account manager for your orders and questions

Why add Quamtrax to your range?

Quamtrax fits a range for athletes, fitness customers and active consumers. The products cover:
